title: Megurine Luka — Elegant Smile〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Honami, thank you for drawing a fortune for me.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You don't need to thank me...
I mean, especially considering the outcome...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, I don't think it was really all that bad.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <If this is rock bottom in terms of my luck, things can only get better from here.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Luka...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, did you all draw fortunes already?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No. Only for Miku and Luka.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then what are we waiting for? Let's see what we get!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Honami, why not draw another one?
I'm sure it'll be better this time!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. Let's hope for the best!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Honami seems pretty fired up...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, she is. So are we getting our fortunes, or what?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Okay, what did you get?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Minor blessing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Huh... Oh, look at the part about education!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Be sure to work hard, but your rewards will be modest...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, so I won't get good grades even if I work hard? How can anyone feel like studying after getting this?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But under general luck it says, Attention to detail will improve your luck.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It could be taken as a warning against carelessness.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see. Like when you accidentally skip one row on a multiple choice test and your answers all end up in the wrong place...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, this is pretty rough.
I'll make sure to be careful...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And what did you get, Saki?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh! I got a... Blessing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Under education it says, Study without worrying!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow... Our fortunes are miles apart...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But under finances it says, Be careful. Avoid impulse buying or you'll greatly regret them later...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Greatly regret them...?
What on earth am I going to buy?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hmm... You could end up buying some clothes at one store and find out later that they're 50% off at another one?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, right... When Saki finds something she really likes, she tends to buy it on the spot.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-Then... I'll be more careful when I'm shopping this year...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What did you get, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll check it now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh! Luka, look! Finally!
A blessing!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <That's great, Honami!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean by finally?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. This is her third try.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? When did she get so many...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <The general luck part is very positive too. It says, Your efforts will bring happiness to those around you.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! I'll do my best to make that come true...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Calm down a little. You're acting like you just drew a great blessing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Did you, Shiho?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I got a good blessing. That's good enough for me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... Shiho's the best of us all, then Honami and me, and then Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hold on, I'm getting another one.
I mean, Honami had a few tries so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What did you get before this one, Hona? Don't tell me you drew a great curse or something...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Eek...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I knew it!
Come on! Show me that one!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <They're really enjoying this.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh? Why are you sighing while staring at your fortune?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You got a good blessing, right?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. And the part about education not being a problem is nice. But the part about wishes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Let's see... You'll worry others and have difficult choices to make...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That's odd. The rest of the fortune is very good, but this part doesn't bode all that well.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes. But I don't think you should worry about it too much, Shiho.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <If you let it get to you, it might stop you from accomplishing what you've set out to do and turn into a self-fulfilling prophecy.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right. It's just a fortune...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shiho! Let's tie up our fortunes!
We can make our wish plaques after that!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, I thought we already did everything?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Luka, they're writing their wishes next!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes. I guess we get to enjoy this shrine visit a little bit longer.>
